Let's construct our matrix:

- The index $2$ in ${J}_{2}(e)$ means that we have a $2\times 2$ matrix.

- The value $e$ in ${J}_{2}(e)$ means that we have $e$'s on the main diagonal.

- Also, we must have $1$'s on the superdiagonal (the diagonal above the main one).

Given that all the other entries must be zero, our Jordan block is

$$
{J}_{2}(e)=[\begin{aligned}e & 1 \\ 0 & e\end{aligned}].
$$
